_about: Goals: Settings only sets what Goals start with; Goals are started, watched and stopped in the assistant chat (or handed over by the Planning Wizard), so there is no Active Goals tab. The progress view's rows are Defaults, the receipt is explained under Checks (earned, not chosen), a Goal's kind is set per template, and Recovery and Checks are one control each.
